implementations.callTemplate:
model <- lm(`<response>` ~ `<covariate>` + `<fixed_effect>`, data = <dataset>)
model_summary <- summary(model)
anova_result <- car::Anova(model, type = "<ss_type>")
lsm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ `<fixed_effect>`)
lsm_df <- as.data.frame(summary(lsm, infer = TRUE, level = 1 - <alpha>))
contr <- pairs(lsm, adjust = "<multiplicity_adjustment>")
contr_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contr, infer = TRUE, level = 1 - <alpha>))
implementations.notes: ANCOVA via lm() with Type III SS from car::Anova() and LS means from emmeans. Covariate adjusts the group comparison.
Row-wise subtraction: difference = minuend - subtrahend. Used by T.ChangeFromBaseline (Change = current value - baseline value). Operates on concept-keyed columns.

implementations.callTemplate:
agg_fn <- switch("<agg_func>",
  sum = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  count = function(x) sum(!is.na(x)),
  mean = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  max = function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  min = function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)
partition_cols <- strsplit("<partition>", " \\+ ")[[1]]
partition_cols <- partition_cols[partition_cols %in% colnames(concept_data)]
val_col <- "<value>"
result_col <- "<result>"
# Source for aggregation: prefer the leaf snapshot if it has the value column
# (sibling aggregations after upstream rollups would otherwise have nothing
# to aggregate), else fall back to the running cube (for aggregations over
# upstream-derived columns whose leaf form doesn't exist).
src <- if (!is.null(concept_data_leaf) && val_col %in% colnames(concept_data_leaf)) concept_data_leaf else concept_data
if (!(val_col %in% colnames(src))) {
  stop(sprintf("M.Aggregation: value column '%s' not found. concept_data: %s. concept_data_leaf: %s", val_col, paste(colnames(concept_data), collapse=", "), if (is.null(concept_data_leaf)) "<null>" else paste(colnames(concept_data_leaf), collapse=", ")))
}
if (length(partition_cols) > 0) {
  agg_result <- aggregate(
    stats::as.formula(paste0("`", val_col, "` ~ ", paste0("`", partition_cols, "`", collapse = " + "))),
    data = src, FUN = agg_fn
  )
  colnames(agg_result)[colnames(agg_result) == val_col] <- result_col
  # Broadcast the per-group aggregate back onto the running cube. Cube
  # collapse + slice projection happen ONCE at chain end (in the engine
  # post-processing), not here — different aggregations in a chain may
  # partition on different dimensions (e.g. per-Parameter max, per-Subject
  # sum), so collapsing at each step would destroy lookups for siblings.
  if (result_col %in% colnames(concept_data)) concept_data[[result_col]] <- NULL
  concept_data <- merge(concept_data, agg_result, by = partition_cols, all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  concept_data[[result_col]] <- agg_fn(as.numeric(src[[val_col]]))
}
implementations.notes: Aggregation within partition groups. Config <agg_func> selects function (sum, count, mean, max, min). Result is merged back as a new column. Used by ADAS-Cog sub-derivations (sum of available scores, non-missing count, missing scale capacity, item max score).

implementations.callTemplate:
val <- as.numeric(concept_data[["<value>"]])
thresh <- <threshold>
op <- "<operator>"
true_val <- "<true_value>"
false_val <- "<false_value>"
cmp <- switch(op,
  ">="  = val >= thresh,
  ">"   = val > thresh,
  "<="  = val <= thresh,
  "<"   = val < thresh,
  "=="  = val == thresh,
  "!="  = val != thresh,
  val >= thresh
)
concept_data[["<result>"]] <- ifelse(cmp, true_val, false_val)
implementations.notes: Row-wise threshold comparison producing a flag column. Used by T.ADAS_ScoreableCheck (checks if non-missing count meets minimum threshold for scoring).

implementations.callTemplate:
# Windowed visit assignment. Reads a pre-computed study day (SDTM --DY,
# concept-keyed as <day>) and for each row finds the scheduled visit whose
# window contains that day. Ties broken by |day - targetDay| then min visitNumber.
# <day> → concept-keyed column name (e.g. 'Timing', materialised from QSDY).
# <analysisVisit>, <analysisVisitNumber>, <analysisDay> → output columns.
# configs$windows is a list of list(label, visitNumber, dayMin, dayMax, targetDay).
windows_def <- configs$windows
if (is.null(windows_def) || length(windows_def) == 0) stop("M.WindowedVisitAssignment: configs$windows is empty.")
day_raw <- concept_data[["<day>"]]
if (is.null(day_raw)) stop(sprintf("M.WindowedVisitAssignment: missing column '<day>'. have=%s", paste(colnames(concept_data), collapse=", ")))
day_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(day_raw))
# Normalise windows_def → vectors for faster lookups.
w_label <- vapply(windows_def, function(w) as.character(w$label %||% ""), character(1))
w_vnum  <- vapply(windows_def, function(w) { v <- w$visitNumber; if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v) }, numeric(1))
w_min   <- vapply(windows_def, function(w) { v <- w$dayMin; if (is.null(v)) -Inf else as.numeric(v) }, numeric(1))
w_max   <- vapply(windows_def, function(w) { v <- w$dayMax; if (is.null(v))  Inf else as.numeric(v) }, numeric(1))
w_tgt   <- vapply(windows_def, function(w) { v <- w$targetDay; if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v) }, numeric(1))
assign_one <- function(d) {
  if (is.na(d)) return(c(NA_character_, NA_real_))
  hits <- which(d >= w_min & d <= w_max)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(c(NA_character_, NA_real_))
  if (length(hits) > 1) {
    dist <- abs(d - w_tgt[hits])
    hits <- hits[dist == min(dist, na.rm = TRUE)]
    if (length(hits) > 1) {
      hits <- hits[which.min(w_vnum[hits])]
    }
  }
  c(w_label[hits], w_vnum[hits])
}
assigned <- vapply(day_num, assign_one, character(2))
concept_data[["<analysisVisit>"]]       <- assigned[1, ]
concept_data[["<analysisVisitNumber>"]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(assigned[2, ]))
concept_data[["<analysisDay>"]]         <- day_num
implementations.notes: Row-wise visit assignment on a pre-computed study day (<day>, e.g. the Timing concept = SDTM QSDY). Reads configs$windows (not a template placeholder — arrays can't be stringified, so they're bound directly to the R env). Output columns are concept-keyed (<analysisVisit> substituted with e.g. 'AnalysisVisit'). `%||%` is defined in acdc_engine.R. The referenceBC method config is metadata only — the SAP anchor is already encoded in --DY at ingest time.

Row-wise conditional. If <value> is NA, output <alternate>; else output <base> (numeric, default 0). Used by T.ADAS_MissingContribution to mask each row's item-max-score by item presence: missing → max-score, present → 0. Then aggregating that sum per Subject×Visit gives the total scale capacity of missing items.

Row-wise affine transform: result = scale * value + offset. Used by T.ADAS_ScoreableFraction with scale = -1/70 and offset = 1 to compute (70 - missing_capacity) / 70. Generic enough to cover any linear rescaling on a single column (e.g. NPI-X, CIBIC+ scoring fractions, percent-of-max conversions).

implementations.callTemplate:
# Row-wise unit conversion operating on concept-keyed columns.
# Placeholders <value>, <source_unit>, <result_value>, <result_unit>
# are substituted with concept names (e.g. 'Observation.Result.Value')
# which ARE the internal dataframe column names after the load phase.
uc <- unit_conversions$conversions
target <- "<target_unit>"
precision <- <precision>
rounding_method <- "<rounding_method>"
on_missing <- "<on_missing_factor>"
factor_for <- function(src) {
  for (row in uc) {
    if ((tolower(row$from_code) == tolower(src) || tolower(row$from_name) == tolower(src)) &&
        (tolower(row$to_code) == tolower(target) || tolower(row$to_name) == tolower(target))) return(row$factor)
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}
src <- as.character(concept_data[["<source_unit>"]])
val <- as.numeric(concept_data[["<value>"]])
f <- vapply(src, factor_for, numeric(1))
missing_idx <- which(is.na(f) & !is.na(val))
if (length(missing_idx) > 0) {
  msg <- sprintf("Missing unit conversion factor for source values: %s (target=%s)",
                 paste(unique(src[missing_idx]), collapse = ", "), target)
  if (on_missing == "fail") stop(msg)
  if (on_missing == "na") val[missing_idx] <- NA_real_
  if (on_missing == "passthrough") f[missing_idx] <- 1
}
result_value <- val * f
if (!is.null(precision) && !is.na(precision)) {
  result_value <- switch(rounding_method,
    half_up   = round(result_value, precision),
    half_even = round(result_value, precision),
    half_down = sign(result_value) * floor(abs(result_value) * 10^precision + 0.5 - 1e-9) / 10^precision,
    floor     = floor(result_value * 10^precision) / 10^precision,
    ceiling   = ceiling(result_value * 10^precision) / 10^precision,
    round(result_value, precision)
  )
}
concept_data[["<result_value>"]] <- result_value
concept_data[["<result_unit>"]]  <- target
# Stamp the endpoint-defined Parameter label on every converted row so the
# downstream analysis cube can filter by Parameter == <parameter_label>.
concept_data[["Parameter"]] <- "<parameter_label>"
implementations.notes: Generic row-wise unit conversion. Reads from concept-keyed columns <value> and <source_unit>, writes concept-keyed columns <result_value> and <result_unit>. Substitution of placeholders with concept names (e.g. Observation.Result.Value, Measure.Result.Value) is done by the engine's execute phase based on the transformation's bindings. Config placeholders (<target_unit>, <precision>, <rounding_method>, <on_missing_factor>) are substituted from the endpoint's resolved configurationValues. Requires `unit_conversions` (loaded from model/vocabularies/unit_conversions.json) and `concept_data` (the concept-keyed internal representation after the load phase) to be present in the R eval env. derivationKind='rowwise_mutate' tells the engine this is a pre-analysis dataframe mutation, not an analysis aggregation.
